name: Rábcakapi (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rábcakapi (a blue and red shield with a fish, a church and ears of grain) below the name RÁPCAKAPI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
